findings.body:
**Pass `allTests` to `planRun`, or the full-suite refusal never runs.**

`planRun` (scripts/lib/test-narrow.mjs:130-137) refuses a selection that covers every test only when `allTests.length > 0`. This call does not pass `allTests`, so the parameter defaults to `[]` and the check is skipped.

`selectAffected` does not flag broad mapped selections as fallbacks. For example, a change to `package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `tsconfig*.json`, `test/fixtures/**` or `test/helpers/**` maps to `/^(test|lint)\//`, which is every test, with `fallback: false`. The gated-class refusal then tells the caller to re-run with `--include-integration --include-live`. With those flags, the full suite runs locally. The file header (Line 3) says "The full suite is CI-only".

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-const plan = planRun({ selection, manifest, include: opts.include });
+const plan = planRun({ selection, manifest, include: opts.include, allTests });
```
</details>

findings.body:
**Reject inverted size tiers after merging.**

In `cqConfigDefaults.ts:87-108`, a flag value of `small.maxChangedLines = 300` and a config value of `medium.maxChangedLines = 250` produce an inverted policy. Each value passes validation against the other tier’s default.

Validate the resolved size before returning it. Reject an inversion without silently clamping it.
